additional_info.subject: Technical Questions Regarding SicD with Monta
additional_info.body:
Hello,
One of our customers is working with Monta on the backend and has sent us the following questions. We would like to clarify the situation by forwarding these questions to you and obtaining your responses:
We are working with Monta on the backend, and on our portal, we have an "Unlock" function to unlock a socket that is in a locked state. However, Monta has informed us that this function is not supported on Siemens units. We would like to confirm this from you.
In the tests we conducted through Monta, the charging-related data (SOC, consumption, etc.) appears in the application 1:50 minutes after the operation. Monta states that this data comes from the unit in this manner. However, as far as we know, Siemens transmits information every 30 seconds. Can you provide us with data that would help us clarify this situation and prove the correct information?
I appreciate your help.
With best regards,
Yunus Emre Temel

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0400972-DC/Si-D/TR-[null] Technical Query CRM:01811000604
additional_info.body:
Dear Yunus,
Thank you for your query.
Regarding the DC socket with a fixed cable, please note that it cannot be unlocked. As per the OCPP 1.6 sheet v4.0 (Release 2019-10-23), the response to an unlock command is listed as "not supported."
Unfortunately, I cannot evaluate ABB's behavior here. I recommend reaching out to them to inquire about the specific standard or protocol version that allows this feature.
Once we have that information, we can cross-check it accordingly.
Let me know if you need further assistance!
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0400972-DC/Si-D/TR-[null] Technical Query CRM:01811000604
additional_info.body:
Hello  Yunus,
Could you please check the current set value of the
MeterValueSampleInterval
in the backend settings? If it is set to 110 seconds, the system will transmit data every 110 seconds i.e. 1.50 min. However, if you wish to transmit the information every 30 seconds, the value should be adjusted to 30 seconds.
Kindly verify the setting in the backend and make the necessary adjustments.
Please let me know if you need any further assistance.
Thank you for your attention to this matter.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
